title: HONNE at Wanderland
description: HONNE performing live at Wanderland Music & Arts Festival. Warm synths, intimate vocals, and dreamy stage lights captured from the crowd.

photos.caption: The stage under an inflatable character and cloud set, the crowd in silhouette.
At the mic in a cap, guitar slung, the drummer behind.
Wide from the crowd — the W stage washed red, arms up across the field.
The full set lit orange, the inflatable character glowing over the band.
The same stage from further back, gold light spilling over raised hands.
Mid-line at the mic, arm out, against deep blue.
At the keys under red light, close and side-on.
The LED wall in red with the band in silhouette in front of it.
Guitarist in a yellow cap and goggles, lens flare across the frame.
Wide across the crowd, red light and phone screens all the way back.
The stage seen through the crowd, haze catching the beam.
Close on the guitarist — yellow bucket hat, round red goggles.
Two figures on the stage lip, the inflatable set piece looming behind.
The guitarist at the mic, the red set filling the background.
Shot from low at the barrier, guitar neck cutting across the frame.
Arms up on the stage lip, the crowd's lights below.
Kneeling at the keys, half-lost in shadow.
A single blinder flaring across the stage, a figure at the keys.
Alone at centre stage under one hard light, a starburst of flare.
